method: Partition each saved City parent independently into120m centroid cells. Preserve all100-byte encoded triangle rows, including normals, UVs and material indices. Street/Crowd meshes remain unchanged. Each child keeps the old parent CSV residency bounds, while Unreal derives tighter renderer bounds from its actual geometry.
proof: One exact duplicate-preserving Counter per bounded400000-triangle parent, compared with independently reopened child mesh files. No approximate floating-point comparison or geometry simplification.
cleanup: After every child asset is validated, remove only recorded replaced parent assets that have no Unreal asset referencers. References, source inputs and accepted circuits are preserved.
limitations: Renderer primitive grouping and draw/streaming costs change. Byte-preserved geometry alone does not prove identical images or faster rendering; both require fresh runtime checks.
